species.name: Tyrannosaurus rex
species.anatomy: Massive deep skull, tiny two-fingered forearms, strong two hind legs and balancing tail; no horns, plates or sail.

species.name: Triceratops
species.anatomy: Exactly THREE horns: two long brow horns and one shorter nose horn, wide bony neck frill, beak, four stout legs.

species.name: Stegosaurus
species.anatomy: Two staggered rows of large upright back plates, four long tail spikes, tiny head, short front legs and higher hindquarters.

species.name: Brachiosaurus
species.anatomy: Very long upright neck, small head, FRONT legs noticeably longer than hind legs, high shoulders, long tail; no plates.

species.name: Diplodocus
species.anatomy: Long low horizontal neck, tiny narrow head, long slender whip-like tail, four columnar legs with lower front than Brachiosaurus.

species.name: Ankylosaurus
species.anatomy: Wide low armored body with broad bony back scutes, small low head, FOUR stout legs, conspicuous blunt bony TAIL CLUB.

species.name: Spinosaurus
species.anatomy: Tall curved back sail, elongated narrow crocodile-like snout, strong hind legs, long deep flattened tail, grasping forelimbs; no horns.

species.name: Velociraptor
species.anatomy: Small lightly built FEATHERED raptor, wing-like feathered arms, long feathered tail, enlarged raised sickle-shaped second toe claws, no naked scaly movie raptor.

species.name: Allosaurus
species.anatomy: Large meat-eating biped, THREE fingers per forelimb, low paired crests above eyes, large head and long balancing tail.

species.name: Apatosaurus
species.anatomy: Robust long-necked sauropod, thick muscular neck held forward, long tapering tail and FOUR sturdy columnar legs; no sails or horns.

species.name: Camarasaurus
species.anatomy: Sturdy long-necked sauropod, relatively boxy blunt skull, high arched snout, broad body, four thick legs, fairly stout tail.

species.name: Iguanodon
species.anatomy: Large herbivore with a beaked muzzle, long tail, robust hind legs and shorter forelegs, a pointed THUMB SPIKE on each hand.

species.name: Parasaurolophus
species.anatomy: Duck-billed herbivore, conspicuous long smooth TUBULAR crest sweeping backwards from head, four legs, long tail; crest is not a horn.

species.name: Corythosaurus
species.anatomy: Duck-billed herbivore with a high rounded HELMET-shaped head crest, long balancing tail and four walking legs.

species.name: Lambeosaurus
species.anatomy: Duck-billed herbivore with a hatchet-shaped hollow head crest: broad forward blade and small backward projecting spur; long tail.

species.name: Edmontosaurus
species.anatomy: Large broad flat duck bill, NO tall bony head crest or horns, bulky herbivore body, four walking limbs and long balancing tail.

species.name: Maiasaura
species.anatomy: Gentle duck-billed herbivore, small low bony bump above eyes rather than a giant crest, broad bill, four legs and long tail.

species.name: Pachycephalosaurus
species.anatomy: Bipedal herbivore with a very thick smoothly rounded skull DOME, small bumps around the rear skull, short forelimbs and long tail.

species.name: Homalocephale
species.anatomy: Small bipedal plant-eater with a FLAT relatively broad skull roof instead of a tall dome, tiny forelimbs and slender long tail.

species.name: Psittacosaurus
species.anatomy: Small bipedal herbivore with a curved PARROT-like beak, NO long face horns or large neck frill, short forelimbs and tail with a sparse bristle fringe.

species.name: Protoceratops
species.anatomy: Small stout FOUR-legged herbivore with a parrot-like beak and a large bony neck frill but NO long brow horns; small nose bump only.

species.name: Styracosaurus
species.anatomy: FOUR-legged horned herbivore, ONE long nose horn and conspicuous long spikes projecting from the rim of the neck frill; no Triceratops long brow horns.

species.name: Centrosaurus
species.anatomy: FOUR-legged horned herbivore with a prominent single nasal horn, short neck frill with small rim knobs and paired inward-curving hook ornaments at top.

species.name: Pachyrhinosaurus
species.anatomy: Stout FOUR-legged horned herbivore with a broad thick blunt bony nasal BOSS, NOT a long pointed nose horn, and a bony neck frill with small rim ornaments.

species.name: Carnotaurus
species.anatomy: Bipedal meat-eater with TWO short thick horns above the eyes, deep short blunt skull, extremely tiny forearms and long muscular tail.

species.name: Ceratosaurus
species.anatomy: Bipedal meat-eater with a clear single short NOSE HORN, low ridges above eyes and a row of small bony bumps along back, long tail.

species.name: Dilophosaurus
species.anatomy: Slender biped with TWO thin parallel arched crests atop the head, long tail and forearms; NO neck frill, NO venom effect or fantasy wings.

species.name: Coelophysis
species.anatomy: Slender early bipedal meat-eater with a long narrow pointed head, thin curved neck, slim body, delicate forelimbs and long thin tail.

species.name: Compsognathus
species.anatomy: Very small lightly built biped with a narrow head, long neck and tail and thin legs; short feather fringe may be understated, no head horns.

species.name: Gallimimus
species.anatomy: Ostrich-like biped, small toothless beaked head, long neck, very long running legs, feathered body and forearms and long tail, no wings suited for flight.

species.name: Ornithomimus
species.anatomy: Slender bird-mimic biped with small toothless beak, long neck, long legs, conspicuous feathered wing-like arms and long balancing tail.

species.name: Oviraptor
species.anatomy: Small feathered biped with a short deep parrot-like toothless beak, a modest head crest, feathered wing-like arms, long tail plume and no stolen eggs.

species.name: Therizinosaurus
species.anatomy: Large feathered bipedal plant-eater with a small beaked head, long neck, broad pot belly, and THREE extraordinarily long gently curved CLAWS on each long forearm.

species.name: Deinonychus
species.anatomy: FEATHERED raptor with long feathered forearms, rigid balancing tail, enlarged sickle-shaped raised second toe claw and bigger deep head than Velociraptor.

species.name: Microraptor
species.anatomy: Very small fully FEATHERED dinosaur with long feathers on BOTH forelimbs and hindlimbs (four wing surfaces), long feathered tail and tiny head; gentle walking wing-folded cycle.

species.name: Baryonyx
species.anatomy: Biped with a long narrow crocodile-like snout, low back without giant sail, ONE large curved thumb claw per grasping forelimb and long tail.

species.name: Suchomimus
species.anatomy: Biped with a very long narrow crocodile-like snout and small low raised ridge along back rather than a towering Spinosaurus sail; long forearms and tail.

species.name: Giganotosaurus
species.anatomy: Huge bipedal meat-eater with a long low deep skull, THREE clawed fingers per forelimb, powerful hind legs and long balancing tail; no horns or sail.

species.name: Argentinosaurus
species.anatomy: Enormous long-necked plant-eating sauropod, extremely broad heavy torso, four thick columnar legs, long neck and tapering tail, small head; no back sail.

species.name: Saltasaurus
species.anatomy: Compact relatively small sauropod with long neck and tail, four columnar legs and distinctive small rounded bony armor scutes across the back; no tail club.
